etsy.title: I Said Left Rally Car Poster, Funny Co-Driver Wall Art, Rally Driver Gift, Garage Race Decor
etsy.description:
A funny rally car poster with a co-driver's frustrated call in intercom style: I SAID LEFT, with two choices—Left and Other left.

WHAT YOU'LL GET
• A physical poster print, shipped directly to you
• Available in 11×17 in
• Printed on premium matte paper at 300 DPI

HOW TO USE
Frame and hang it in a garage, man cave, home office, or on a rally fan's wall. A great gift for the navigator who never gets listened to.

An original design with no team, series, or manufacturer marks.

This listing is a physical poster print. Thank you for supporting a small shop!

competitorNotes: No co-driver humor posters found on Etsy; humor products in the rally niche are limited to T-shirts, hoodies, and bumper stickers.
The closest co-driver-specific item is a hoodie with 'CO-DRIVER NAVIGATOR' branding and pace note symbols on the back.
Definition-style funny rally prints exist but focus on the driver, not the co-driver's perspective.
On Amazon, co-driver items are only apparel: a 'Rally Pace Notes Co Driver' T-shirt and a rally driver joke tote bag.
No funny co-driver posters or prints found on Amazon.

research.notes: Keyword phrases from research/keywords/rally.json (search-results, 2026-11-01). 'funny rally car poster' combines humor angle with the indexed 'rally car poster'. Co-driver humor posters are a gap on both Etsy and Amazon. 'i said left' has no search evidence; it is the printed text. No priceRange: comparable humor rally prints were not found.
